Laurey 57166, Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Small Oil Rubbed Bronze Newport Cabinet Pull has 96mm center to centers. The Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with mounting hardware. The 96mm Newport Pull Oil Rubbed Bronze can be used as a kitchen cabinet pull or also in the bathroom or on furniture.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57166 96mm Pull Newport Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3.78" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4.61"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
